key_decisions: MPI-1268 is NOT dev-gated (Fabio, twice): it ships in the next bug-fix release.

Whole pictures: an even grid at the pictures' median shape, nothing cropped; the grid showing the most picture wins, a 1-wide strip of 4+ only if 1/0.85 better (STRIP_PENALTY). Create Sheet opens with it on; Combine keeps cropping by default.
Agents (MCP make_sheet, Cosmo) keep the SHEET_SHAPES enum; only the dialog sends free w:h labels.
constraints: Shared tree: commit through a private index (scratch script pattern: read-tree HEAD, update-index --cacheinfo, commit-tree, update-ref with old HEAD); the root events.jsonl holds thousands of peers' uncommitted lines, commit HEAD + your own lines only.

An app:isolated copy needs APP_DOCUMENTS + its own CUBRIC_AGENT_PROFILE (absolute) and a NEW port per code change (the pane caches modules); close each via the listener's PARENT with taskkill /T. Port 3000 is Fabio's.
docs/stacks.md is 202 lines, 2 over the 200 cap.
